data.name: Nuzhaht
data.gender_notes: Nuzhaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Nuzhah’ which means delight, pleasure and enjoyment. Nuzhaht is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking feelings of happiness, joy and contentment. The name Nuzhaht carries the meaning “Delight, Pleasure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Nuzhaht usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the joy and happiness that comes from connecting with the divine.
data.etymology: Nuzhaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Pleasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuzhaht total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
